newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PG&E plans A$1 bln Australian pipeline.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PG&E plans A$1 bln Australian pipeline.

text.p: U.S. energy giant Pacific Gas & Electric Corp, said it is seeking approval from the Western Australian government to build and operate a A$1 billion natural gas pipeline in Western Australia.

The 1,600-kilometre gas pipeline would tap gas supplies from the State's North West Shelf gas fields to deliver energy supplies to customers throughout south-west areas, Michael McDanold managing director of PGT Australia Pty Ltd, the local unit of Pacific Gas and Electric, said in a statement.
"The gas pipeline will create the first comprehensive gas grid in Australia and will be a tremendous benefit to Western Australia," McDanold said.
"PGT Australia's south-west Australia natural (SWAN) gas pipeline will provide massive additional capacity at lower prices."
Pipeline construction was planned to start in mid-1998 after consultations with landowners, indigenous communities and local government on the pipeline route, McDanold said.

PGT Australia owns and operates the former Queensland state government-owned gas pipeline which delivers supplies from Roma in the north of the State to the coastal cities of Gladstone and Rockhampton.
